rationale: Springer/Springer Nature venues may support independent scholarly publication when venue standing is documented.
indexing: Attach record-specific indexing evidence such as Scopus, Web of Science, DBLP, Google Scholar, or venue page.
impactMetric: Attach citation, acceptance, publisher, or venue-impact evidence from the record where available.

rationale: IGI Global may support authorship/publication evidence when indexing and review method are documented.
indexing: Attach publisher indexing, catalog, or database listing evidence specific to the publication.
impactMetric: Attach citation, adoption, chapter-download, or venue-standing evidence where available.

rationale: Frontiers venues may support peer-reviewed authorship evidence when the article and venue standing are documented.
indexing: Attach indexing evidence for the specific Frontiers journal or article.
impactMetric: Attach article metrics, citations, journal page, or other standing proof from the record.
